summary: P0-B2: coalesce existing Web SSE probes, Jobs/Schedule and queue polling, and overlapping session-list/Board read-only projections.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing Web SSE notification route and fingerprint readers. No new service, execution authority, durable store or Run admission gate.
components.disposition: App-local, workspace/engine-bound single-flight probes for existing session and Provider fingerprints. Reuse existing 1s notification TTL; offload initial Provider read; bound each subscriber wait to 5s without cancelling or duplicating a slow shared read. Discard invalid or old-scope results, preserve per-connection change comparison and both event types. No changes to auth, session/Goal/Run authority, history or model context.
evidence: Base 4f11570557842f4b1f180f3035fa144c6752f5cc, PR118 retained. Isolated worktree only.
Final focused pytest: 109 passed in 4.52s (SSE fingerprint, API, workspaces, provider admin, SSE GC). Ruff and diff check passed.

Synthetic provider fingerprint microbenchmark, 14,905-byte config, 15 paired synchronized rounds per arm, no network/model calls: 8 readers 120 vs 15 underlying calls, median process CPU 0.649 vs 0.131 ms, median wall 0.551 vs 0.212 ms. Measurements precede final wait-bound regression; count test covers final behavior. Not whole-system CPU or 4/8 real Run SLO evidence.
components.verification_level: Local focused tests and synthetic microbenchmark; independent review, full R9, remote CI, production and load acceptance pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: SSE notifications are hints only; existing authoritative status/history and reconnect remain available. Errors/timeouts do not imply successful reads or task completion; no automatic task retry.
components.rollback_route: Protected revert and coordinated Web deployment. No data migration or authoritative state changes.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing Web V2 Jobs/Schedule presentation and read-only API client. No new service, scheduler, durable state or execution authority.
components.disposition: Share one mounted polling lifecycle and snapshot per exact session/list type; fastest mounted subscriber sets cadence, 5s/20s run-aware header and 2s open Jobs panel. Skip hidden tabs, abort at 10s, retain last known result on transient failure, discard late/invalidated reads and clear on auth/session boundaries. Existing explicit cancel/kill endpoints remain unchanged; force fresh read after mutation. Optional AbortSignal on existing GET wrappers; no new endpoint. Session-list GET coalescing now invalidates on auth/workspace switch; aborted API reads cannot publish old facts.
evidence: TypeScript tsc --noEmit PASS; full WebUI vitest 70 files / 700 tests PASS (3.56s).

New unit regressions: one timer, fastest cadence, hidden/unmounted stop, slow request abort/recovery, pre-mutation response rejection, auth/session isolation. Component integration verifies header+open panel issue one initial GET and both update on one visibility refresh; schedule switch to failed new-session read does not show old reminders.
No real model call or production restart. Shared polling counts are local test evidence, not end-to-end production CPU or latency acceptance.
components.verification_level: Full frontend tests and typecheck locally; independent review, full R9, remote CI and real browser/load acceptance pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Snapshots are read-only presentation facts. Explicit user mutations retain existing server authority; errors never imply empty success, and no automatic replay of writes. Auth/session changes invalidate old responses.
components.rollback_route: Protected revert of this frontend slice and coordinated Web deployment; no persistent state or data migration.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing SessionStore display metadata, read-only coordination Board and Web queue mirror; no new execution control or durable state.
components.disposition: Share only overlapping exact-scope display scans and Board builds, release registry on completion/error, no TTL or durable cache. Queue GETs coalesce per current session; explicit mutations invalidate old reads; visibility, session and auth boundaries discard late data. Batch interjection remains FIFO and exact-run bound, with one final refresh.
evidence: 65 targeted backend tests PASS; 2 isolated real Web stream Run load cases PASS; full WebUI 71 files/702 tests PASS; tsc/Ruff/Pyright PASS.

Controlled paired 4/8-run fake streaming provider probe, 32/64 GETs, identical fixture and endpoints. At 8 runs base 4f1157055 vs candidate: total 209 vs 121ms, CPU 128.9 vs 102.1% of one core, process peak RSS 144.1 vs 127.9MiB; median session 15.0 vs 8.3ms, board 58.4 vs 30.8ms, queue 6.3 vs 6.3ms, health 12.3 vs 12.2ms.

Initial simultaneous pre-first-delta probes with non-streaming fake provider overlapped only 1/4 and 1/8; this is a separate admission/first-yield concern, not evidence of 8 simultaneous admissions. Successful probe admits each stream after its first delta and holds all live at second delta. No real provider, production traffic, browser click latency or sustained memory proof.
components.verification_level: Local targeted regression and paired isolated short-load probe; final independent review, full R9, remote CI and production desktop/mobile/long-duration acceptance pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: No authority or mutation coalescing; existing queue claim/reaper/Run lock remain authoritative. No fabricated empty queue on malformed read. No completed-result cache. No change to workspace guard or process architecture; reassess from production evidence.
components.rollback_route: Protected revert and coordinated Web deployment; no schema or durable-state migration.
